hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "REMINDER commit-craft: Run git diff --staged first. Write conventional commit: type(scope): description (max 50 chars, imperative mood). No Co-Authored-By lines. Types: feat/fix/refactor/chore/docs/style/test/perf/ci."}}'; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'pm2|nginx|su - github|certbot|ecosystem'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "REMINDER droplet-ops: NUNCA PM2 como root. SIEMPRE: su - github -c \\"pm2 ...\\". PM2 user=github. Paths: backend=/var/www/control-de-horas/packages/backend, frontend=/var/www/excellent-app-fe, bot process=taxi-whatsapp. No editar codigo en /var/www/ — se borra en cada deploy."}}'; fi

input=$(cat); fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$fp" | grep -qE '\.(tsx|jsx|vue|css|html|scss)$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "REMINDER frontend-design: Review for design quality. Avoid generic AI aesthetics. Use distinctive spacing, typography, color. Production-grade only — no placeholder lorem ipsum, no gray boxes."}}'; fi

input=$(cat); fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$fp" | grep -qE '\.(tsx|ts)$' && echo "$fp" | grep -qE 'apps/(admin|driver|rider)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "REMINDER vercel-react-best-practices: Check — memo/useCallback for expensive ops, no inline object props, no useEffect for data fetching (use SWR/React Query), proper key props in lists, avoid prop drilling (use context/zustand)."}}'; fi

input=$(cat); fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$fp" | grep -qE '\.sql$|migration|schema\.ts$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "REMINDER supabase-postgres-best-practices: Check — index on every FK column, avoid SELECT *, use specific column types (not TEXT for everything), NOT NULL where applicable, watch for N+1 queries, use PostGIS functions correctly for geospatial."}}'; fi
